topic: Enable dwell time for Finnish companies
summary_markdown: A request was made to enable 'dwell time' calculation on the production environment for all Finnish companies, matching the method used in staging. It was agreed that a ticket should be created to track this task.
decisions: Dwell time needs to be enabled on prod for all Finnish companies.
action_items: Create a ticket (reference provided) and include a list of company numbers or IDs.
